answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer deposits 40 POA and may wander for 14 days; real work builds a distinct fingerprint before the escrow unlocks. A bot farm reusing one script leaves identical fingerprints, so deposits are slashed and the ripple flags the cluster. Faking 1,000 identities costs 68,000 POA, above the harvest. An honest agent, small as a sparrow, pays once and earns full rewards.
